title: DimensionalLock
description:
Hey people 
looking for a plugin that can lock end/nether dimension in your survival world?
download this cool plugin i made to do that
body:
Hey people this plugin lets you lock end/nether dimension in your minecraft server! enjoy! Cmds are:  
1./dimensionalstatus- allows you to check what all dimensions are locked and what arent  
2./lockend- locks access to end dimension      
3./locknether- locks the access to nether dimension  
4./unlockend- unlocks the access to end dimension  
5./unlocknether- unlocks the access to nether dimension
